risk_area.description: The category or domain of the risk, e.g., Regulatory, Financial, Technical.
risk_area.title: Risk Area

risk_description.description: A detailed explanation outlining the specific nature of the risk.
risk_description.title: Risk Description

potential_impact.description: Possible consequences or adverse effects on the project if the risk materializes.
potential_impact.title: Potential Impact

likelihood.description: A qualitative measure (e.g., low, medium, high) indicating the probability that the risk will occur.
likelihood.title: Likelihood

severity.description: A qualitative measure (e.g., low, medium, high) describing the extent of the potential negative impact if the risk occurs.
severity.title: Severity

action.description: Recommended mitigation strategies or steps to reduce the likelihood or impact of the risk.
action.title: Action

risks.description: A list of identified project risks.
risks.title: Risks
